_doc: T-205 room acoustics for the spoken lines (VORoomAcoustics, gravelight/world/vo_room_acoustics.gd). The VO bus carries a gentle EQ (AudioEffectEQ6, bands 32/100/320/1000/3200/10000 Hz, dB) and a reverb whose settings come from one preset at a time: the playing cutscene's set (cinema_sets, or a shot's own `vo_room` field), else the map zone the local player stands in (maps.<map_id>.zones), else the map's default, else dry. Lines that already carry their channel from the bake (data/voice/fx.json: the Operator's tannoy, the radios, PA, phonograph, the Cousins' room) and lines cued [radio] / [intercom] / [static] ... play on the VODry bus (same volume, no room). Settings > Audio > Room acoustics (vo_room_acoustics) turns the room off. Keep wet low: you should notice it when it is gone, not when it is on.

dry._what: outside the world: menus, the Archive's black, anything without a space

radio._what: the line's own channel is the space (the bake band-limits radio / tannoy / PA); same as dry

room_wood._what: small wooden room: the inn's taproom and rooms upstairs, barracks, a canteen, a train compartment

room_plaster._what: small plastered / tiled room: an office, a ward, a signal room, the reception

barn_wood._what: a bigger wooden space: the stable

cellar_stone._what: a stone cellar or crypt: low vault, hard walls

church_stone._what: a large stone room: the Salt Chapel

mine_tunnel._what: a mine tunnel, a shaft, a stairwell in rock, the wind tunnel

hall_large._what: a big hard hall: hangar, pen hall, turbine hall, assembly hall, warehouse, silo

bunker_concrete._what: concrete rooms and corridors: the lab, the lower pens, the vaults

dugout._what: a log-roofed dugout: tight, earthy, dead

outdoor._what: outdoors (night, snow, forest, the quay): almost dry, a faint ground reflection, a little air on the top

plane_cabin._what: an aircraft fuselage: tight, metallic, the engines masking the lows and the top

sub_hull._what: inside the U-boat: a steel tube

suit_radio._what: the vacuum yard: no air, so the squad is heard through the suits (band-limited, no room)
